title: Company
description: The org structure the OKR tree hangs off: units and, optionally, the people in them. A node points at the unit that owns it with unitId; owner is the display name derived from that unit.

units.description: Org units, flat with parent pointers in the same style as the OKR tree.

people.description: People, each attached to exactly one unit.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the unit.

parent.description: Id of the parent unit, or null for the top of the org.

lead.description: Id of the person who leads this unit, if known.

charter.description: How this team works and what it owns, written so it can be handed to a model as the team's own voice.

charter.title: TeamCharter
charter.description: A team's job description, written for a reader who knows nothing else about it: someone who saw only this charter should be able to sit in a meeting and argue the team's corner. Every field is optional; write the ones you actually know.

mission.description: Why this team exists, in the team's own words. One or two sentences, stated as the outcome the team is there to produce rather than the activities it performs.

process.description: The business process this team runs, in the team's own words: what comes in, the steps it takes, what it hands off, and on what cadence.

owns.description: The systems, metrics or decisions this team is the accountable owner of. A list rather than prose, so two teams claiming the same thing is visible at a glance.

items.description: One system, metric or decision this team is the accountable owner of, for example "activation rate" or "the pricing page".

dependsOn.description: Ids of the teams in company.units whose output this team needs in order to do its work. References, not prose, so a review can walk the graph.

items.description: Id of another unit in company.units.

person.title: CompanyPerson
person.description: Someone who can own or lead something.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the person.

unitId.description: Id of the unit this person belongs to.
